about: Hand corrections, used instead of the parser's answer. 'requires' uses the notation in notation.py. 'for_text' is the catalog text the correction was written for; if the catalog changes, build_prereqs.py warns instead of applying an outdated answer.

KOR W 3.why: 'KOR 1, 2 or KOR W 1, 2' means (KOR 1 and 2) or (KOR W 1 and 2); the comma list reads as a single AND chain.

MUS 31F.for_text: Placement by audition. Must be taken consecutively. A grade of at least C- required in each of the Music 31 series.
MUS 31F.why: 'Music 31 series' names a series, not a prerequisite course.

PHYS 21.for_text: Mathematics 2A/3A and Mathematics 2B/3B or Physics 8 or AP Calculus BC Exam score of 5.
PHYS 21.why: Mixed and/or with no punctuation; the parser groups 'or' first, which is wrong here.

ME 238.for_text: ME 243A/ECE 230A and at least one class among the following: ME 243B/ECE 230B, ME 236/ECE 236, ME 256/ECE 232, or ME 254/ECE 271C.
ME 238.requires: (ME 243A | ECE 230A) & (ME 243B | ECE 230B | ME 236 | ECE 236 | ME 256 | ECE 232 | ME 254 | ECE 271C)
ME 238.why: 'at least one class among the following:' introduces an OR list after a colon.

C LIT 162I.for_text: Upper Division standing and one course from the following: RGST 19, 20, 140D, 158C, 159 G-H-J-K-L-M-N-O, 160A, 161D, 169 or equivalent; or instructor approval.
C LIT 162I.requires: (@standing & (RG ST 19 | RG ST 20 | RG ST 140D | RG ST 158C | RG ST 159G | RG ST 159H | RG ST 159J | RG ST 159K | RG ST 159L | RG ST 159M | RG ST 159N | RG ST 159O | RG ST 160A | RG ST 161D | RG ST 169 | @other)) | @consent
C LIT 162I.why: Colon list plus '159 G-H-J-K-L-M-N-O' (eight lettered courses).

EARTH 184A.for_text: Environmental Studies 15A and 15B or Chemistry 1A-B; and Geography 3 or 4 or Earth Science 2 or 4 or 20
EARTH 184A.requires: ((ENV S 15A & ENV S 15B) | (CHEM 1A & CHEM 1B)) & (GEOG 3 | GEOG 4 | EARTH 2 | EARTH 4 | EARTH 20)
EARTH 184A.why: '15A and 15B or Chemistry 1A-B': here 'and' groups first.

ECE 152A.for_text: ECE 15A and ECE 2A or ECE 10A & ECE 10AL with a minimum grade of C- in each course; or Computer Science 30 or 64 with a minimum grade of C- in each course; open to electrical engineering, computer engineering, and computer science majors only.
ECE 152A.why: Three-level mix: ECE 15A and (ECE 2A or (ECE 10A and 10AL)).

CMPSC 16.for_text: Mathematics 3A or 2A with a grade of C or better (may be taken concurrently), CS 8 or Engineering 3 or ECE 3 with a grade of C or better, or significant prior programming experience.
CMPSC 16.why: 'A, B, or C' here means A and (B or C), not A or B or C.
